tools.name: search_empty_legs
tools.description: Find current empty-leg flights. Give at least origin or destination (city name or IATA/ICAO code). Returns up to 20 offers with route, date, aircraft, seats, indicative price and a voidjet link plus a pre-filled inquiry link for the user. Provider names are not included. With no match, charter_alter

tools.name: get_empty_leg
tools.description: Current details of one offer by the ref returned by search_empty_legs. available=false means the offer is no longer listed.

tools.name: report_unmet_need
tools.description: Call only when the user has a legitimate need voidjet cannot serve, e.g. no offer on the route, a return flight, pets, instant booking. Choose 1-5 categories; optional route, dates, passengers, budget. Never include personal data. Helps voidjet decide what to add.
